Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mqtt

Class MqttBrokerUri

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.mqtt.MqttBrokerUri
public final class MqttBrokerUri extends Object
A pure, dependency-free parser for the broker connection URIs an MQTT client connects with, of the general form scheme://[user[:password]@]host[:port][/path]. It mirrors the URI forms Eclipse Paho accepts in MqttService.connect(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, boolean, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, int) without pulling in any networking dependency, so it is fully offline-testable.

Recognised schemes, their transport flags and default ports:

  • tcp:// and its alias mqtt:// — plain TCP, port 1883.
  • ssl://, tls://, mqtts:// — TLS over TCP, port 8883 (tls() is true).
  • ws:// — MQTT over WebSocket, port 80 (websocket() is true).
  • wss:// — MQTT over secure WebSocket, port 443 (both tls() and websocket() are true).

Scheme matching is case-insensitive and the canonical (lower-case) scheme is always stored. The path component only applies to the WebSocket schemes: when omitted it defaults to "/mqtt", and for the non-WebSocket schemes it is always null. Any user:password@ userinfo is percent-decoded on parse; normalized() percent-encodes it back so a normalized URI round-trips through parse(String).

Instances are immutable. Malformed input (unknown scheme, missing host, out-of-range or non-numeric port, bad percent-encoding) raises MqttBrokerUriException.
